About us

A Legacy of Trust Since 1968

CMS Subbaiah Nadar Firm has been a trusted name in Madurai, dealing with traditional herbal medicine for over 70 years. We are committed to preserving the rich heritage of nattu marunthu and providing natural, safe and effective herbal products to our valued customers.

A nattu marunthukadai on Swamy Sannathy Lane, off East Masi Street — the old temple-town trade corridor of Madurai. Trade under Manicka Nadar, Siddha Ayurvedic mooligai merchant.

Traditional Knowledge

The wisdom of our Ancestors

For centuries, our ancestors have relied on the healing power of nature. Nattu marunthu is a blend of rich tradition, local herbs and time-tested knowledge passed down through generations.

We continue that legacy — preserving Madurai’s nattu marunthukadai while serving today’s pharmacies, compounders and trade buyers.
